root_cause.class: producer step died mid-cycle after committing an incomplete, non-runnable deliverable
root_cause.durable_delta_of_the_failed_run: exactly one file: evaluation/benchmark_retrieval_counter_authority.py (+331 lines). No state/evaluation.json update, no results/, no reports/, no tests.
root_cause.why_the_delta_was_non_runnable: the committed script re-implemented the frozen-bar scoring loop instead of reusing the accepted run_bar_gates entry point, and crashed on first execution with KeyError: 'negative_control_proven' at line 105 (geometry_gate.score_packet does not emit that key; it is computed inside run_bar_gates via the hostile-geometry control). Secondary defects confirmed by inspection and execution: (a) run_non_vacuity_controls contains a dead for-loop whose body is a bare pass; (b) write_report references record['label_gate']['reinoculated_non_vacuous'] and record['geometry_gate']['n_bundles_pass_all_11'] / ['n_bundles'], none of which score_benchmark_bundles ever sets — a second KeyError waiting after the first; (c) it imports _corrupt and hardcodes query_language='fr' for every qid in a discarded loop. The script also wrote to un-suffixed paths (results/evaluation/retrieval_counter_authority_benchmark.json), breaking the per-run provenance convention used by every other results/evaluation/* record.
candidate_causes_of_the_step_failure_not: LEX_WORK_QUANTUM_EXPIRED (rc 78) — the run lasted ~46 minutes (00:27:24Z to 01:13:46Z), consistent with a quantum boundary
provider/model death after the commit (the standing factory-wide requirement on longcat/muse flapping and backend overloads)
an uncaught producer exception after git commit but before the agent completed its remaining checklist items (state update, report, verification)
root_cause.why_this_is_not_a_scope_violation: step 9 ('Enforce lane write scope') was SKIPPED because step 6 had already failed; the committed delta (evaluation/*) is entirely inside the producer scope. The 38982176936 failure mode does not apply to this run.
root_cause.why_this_is_not_a_state_validation_failu: step 7 ('Validate active MVP producer state') was SKIPPED; had it run, it would have found direction_version 50 and a non-INITIALIZED cycle_status inherited from the base (the same latent gap recorded for 38982176936).
